plain: the order in which people take over a position

webster.text: A following of things in order; consecution; series of things following one another, either in time or place.

more.text: The power or right of coming to the inheritance of ancestors.

example.quote: If an improper spirit of any kind should happen to prevail in it, that spirit would be apt to infuse itself into the new members, as they come forward in succession.
